# Gold Account: How is interest calculated and when is it paid?

## How interest is calculated
- Your APY is 5.5%.
- Interest compounds daily, meaning each day’s accrual is based on your current balance and previously accrued interest.

## When interest is credited
- Interest is credited monthly. You will see the credit as a separate line item on your statement.

## What to expect
- If your balance fluctuates, your daily accrual will adjust accordingly due to daily compounding.
- After the close of each monthly cycle, the total accrued interest posts to your account.

# Gold Account: High-yield savings explained

## How your yield works
- Your Gold Account earns an APY of 5.5%.
- Interest compounds daily, so your daily accrued interest is based on your current balance each day.

## What this means for you
- With daily compounding, your balance can grow faster than with less frequent compounding schedules.
- Keeping funds in the account consistently helps maximize earnings at the 5.5% APY.

## Practical tips
- Avoid unnecessary balance fluctuations to benefit from daily accrual.
- Review your statements to see interest accruing at the 5.5% APY.

# Gold Account at a glance

## Snapshot
- APY: 5.5%
- Minimum balance to maintain the account: $10,000
- Monthly withdrawal limit: 20
- Priority customer support: Yes

## Quick table
| Feature | Value |
| --- | --- |
| APY | 5.5% |
| Minimum balance | $10,000 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 20 |
| Priority support | Yes |

# Gold Plus Account specifications and requirements

## Key specifications

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Opening deposit minimum | $10,000 |
| Minimum balance to maintain | $25,000 |
| Interest compounding frequency | daily |
| Automatic investment sweep threshold | $50,000 |
| Monthly withdrawal limit | 25 withdrawals |

## Requirements to open and maintain

- Fund the account with at least $10,000 at opening.
- Maintain a balance of at least $25,000 to keep account benefits active.
- When your end-of-day available balance exceeds $50,000, excess funds may be moved automatically to your linked investment account according to sweep settings.
- Plan cash flows so you do not exceed 25 withdrawals in a month.
- Interest accrues daily; keeping funds on deposit helps you benefit from compounding.

Quick summary of what likely happened
- Your Gold savings account’s documented APY is 5.5% and interest compounds daily; interest is credited once per month. (Source: Gold Account docs.)
- On $96,000 that gives an expected monthly payment in the same ballpark as what you saw:
  - Using a simple APY/12 approximation: 5.5%/12 × $96,000 ≈ $440
  - Using the exact monthly equivalent of a 5.5% APY (accounts for compounding): (1.055)^(1/12)-1 ≈ 0.4476% → 0.4476% × $96,000 ≈ $430
  - So a typical monthly credit should be roughly $430–$440; your $450 is slightly higher and not unusual depending on day‑by‑day balance changes or any applied bonuses.

Possible reasons your payment might differ from a simple estimate
- Daily compounding and balance swings: APY is applied to your daily balance; if you had higher-than-average balances on some days, the monthly credit can be a bit above the simple /12 estimate.
- APY bonuses or different product: if you actually have Gold Plus (different product) or a credit‑card relationship bonus, effective APY could be higher.
- Automatic sweep or transfers: some accounts (Gold Plus) can sweep amounts above thresholds into a linked investment, which reduces the end‑of‑day savings balance and can change interest credited.
- Promotional or tiered rates: certain credit cards or relationships add a bonus APY (e.g., Gold Rewards Card adds a small bonus). Check your product details to confirm which APY is applied.
